title: Express Best Practices

tableData.title: Production Checklist
rows: Separate route definitions, controllers, and business logic (MVC pattern).
Always use Helmet.js, rate limiting, and parameter validation (Zod/Joi).
Always use a centralized Global Error Handling middleware. Never let promises silently fail.
Enable compression, use connection pooling for databases, and utilize PM2 or Cluster mode.
Use structured logging libraries like Winston or Pino instead of standard `console.log`.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Express Best Practices?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
